title: Production-state surface list — the test/prod membrane (#3615)
description: The committed, single-place list of production state surfaces a test or build context must never write. Each surface names its production path, the env override a test sets to bring its own world (#3528), and where the membrane is enforced. Consumed by chorus-hooks src/shared/membrane.rs (a drift-guard test asserts the Rust Surface enum matches this file 1:1) and mirrored by the TS seams listed per surface. A surface with enforcement 'documented' has no runtime resolver choke point yet — it is listed so the gap is visible, not to claim coverage it doesn't have.

context_contract.description: How a process declares (or betrays) that it is not production. CHORUS_CONTEXT is the explicit contract; the rest are ambient markers already emitted by the runners we use.

explicit.CHORUS_CONTEXT: prod | test | build — explicit wins over all ambient markers
